subject: oasis
name: 绿洲
label: 棕榈环绕的绿洲
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One compact desert oasis scene with a gently curved pool, two palms of different heights, low surrounding dunes and two large rocks.
Center the entire subject with generous empty margin. No tiny repetitive details or hatching; palm fronds if present are 5 to 6 large smooth leaf shapes, with at most three trunk seams. Water has at most two single curved strokes. Do not add any other objects.
